'''Panthin-Dro''' was a male [[Voss (species)|Voss]] commando living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he asked an outsider in the [[Old Paths]] to destroy [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Ssorokk|cyberbeasts]].<ref name="ASA" />
